subject: GROUP

roles.ULT.loc.quote: Top Victory Development Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong and an indirect non-wholly owned subsidiary of the Company as at the Latest Practicable Date

roles.ULT.attrs.incorporated_in.quote: Top Victory Development Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong

roles.OP.loc.quote: Shanghai Knowledge and Innovation Community Development Co., Ltd.*(上海創智天地發展有限公司), a company incorporated in the PRC with limited liability and a non-wholly owned subsidiary of the Company

roles.OP.attrs.incorporated_in.quote: a company incorporated in the PRC with limited liability and a non-wholly owned subsidiary of the Company

roles.BUYER.loc.quote: restructuring through the formation of Limited Partnership and Equity Transfer creates an opportunity to obtain an onshore acquisition loan at Limited Partnership’s level
roles.BUYER.loc.formula: the transferee is a limited partnership to be set up: it takes a domestic acquisition loan at its own level (pdf 9), its general partner is a Mainland company (pdf 4) and its limited partner, the Ningbo fund, is a Mainland limited partnership (pdf 20) — established in the Mainland; the circular does not say so expressly

holds.ULT>OP.ratio.quote: KIC is directly owned as to 99% by Top Victory and 1% by Yangpu Knowledge Innovation.

holds.ULT>OP.since.quote: established on 9 June 2010 with a registered capital of HK$1,550,000,000, which was jointly contributed by Shanghai Yangpu Knowledge Innovation Zone Investment and Development Co., Ltd. and Top Victory Development Limited

holds.ULT>OP.cost.note: the circular only gives the registered capital contribution (HK$1,116,720,000 after the capital reduction) and does not call it the tax cost; a foreign-currency cost is converted at the rate on the day the withholding obligation arises (公告2017年第37号), date not fixed

flows.exit.immovable_ratio.formula: appraised values: net fixed assets 276,932.11 ÷ total assets 283,155.57 (RMB ten thousand, pdf 72) = 97.80%; the fixed assets are almost entirely buildings (pdf 52: net book value RMB1,138,452,196.55)

flows.exit.listed_market_trade.formula: what is transferred is equity in a Mainland limited liability company (pdf 4), not listed shares

present.HOLD.formula: the transferor holds 99% of KIC directly (pdf 20), with no intermediate holding company in between

present.exit_route.quote: the 99% equity interests in KIC will be transferred from Top Victory to the Limited Partnership at the consideration of approximately RMB2,668,000,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$2,925,000,000).

event.exit.quote: the 99% equity interests in KIC will be transferred from Top Victory to the Limited Partnership at the consideration of approximately RMB2,668,000,000

event.on.quote: On 27 November 2024, the Equity Transfer Agreements were entered into by the relevant parties.
event.on.formula: the signing date of the equity transfer agreement is taken; the completion date is not disclosed (no later than 2025-12-31, pdf 17)

notes: Source: Shui On Land (0272.HK) circular of 2024-11-29 (cases/sources/K4-shuion-2024/source.pdf). This case is Top Victory (Hong Kong) transferring 99% of KIC; the YPU transaction is K4-shuion-ypu-2024.
The transferor is held 51% indirectly by the group and consolidated; the company did not disclose the tax withheld (enterprise income tax and stamp duty withheld by the limited partnership, pdf 7).
Amounts are in RMB; the consideration is the approximate figure written in the circular.

names: each party's defined term / full name in the document (aliases separated by /), individuals written as in the document, used for locating extraction patterns, search queries and registry look-ups (抽取改造.md §2, §7)
